heading: How I Can Help
intro: My mission is to prioritise mental health and wellbeing worldwide. I offer a safe space and empower individuals to take proactive and sustainable steps towards improved mental health.

cards.title: Workplace Wellbeing
cards.description: Confidential therapeutic support and wellbeing consultancy for organisations. Employee assistance, stress management programmes and leadership resilience – delivered on-site or remotely. Workplace therapy aims to reduce staff absence due to psychological health, support the phased return of employees and implement a human-centred working culture.

cards.title: Group Sessions
cards.description: Structured group therapy programmes harnessing the therapeutic value of shared experience. Facilitated groups for anxiety, grief and personal development run throughout the year.

cards.title: Remote Sessions
cards.description: Mental health support should work around you. Remote sessions offer confidential therapy on private video or telephone platforms. All service formats are available remotely, to provide full flexibility without compromising clinical quality.
